### Observed differences

- Activity A01 was not observed in the earlier window (0 of 200 traces); in the later window it occurs exactly once in every trace (200 of 200, mean 1.0 occurrence per trace). [OCC001]
- In the earlier window, A06 was the final event of every trace (relative position 1.0 in all 200 traces) and no outgoing transition from A06 was observed; in the later window A06 sits just before the end, at a relative position of about 0.87 (median 0.875). [POS002]
- In the later window, every observed outgoing transition of A06 leads to A01 (share 1.0 across 200 traces); in the earlier window no outgoing transition of A06 was observed at all, consistent with A06 ending every trace. [DIR001, POS002]
- The pair A01–A06 changed from never co-occurring (A06 appeared without A01 in 100% of earlier traces) to co-occurring in 100% of later traces, always in the order A06 before A01. [REL001]
- In the later window, A01 is the final event of every trace (relative position 1.0). [POS001]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that in the later window a final step A01 runs after A06: earlier, traces ended with A06 and A01 was not observed; later, A06 is always followed by A01, which closes every trace, so A06 is no longer the last activity. [OCC001, DIR001, REL001, POS001, POS002]

The support is direct and consistent: five control-flow items qualified where roughly 0.04 would be expected by chance (8 units tested), and all five describe the same end-of-trace insertion from matching angles — occurrence, the new A06→A01 transition, the co-occurrence and order of the pair, and the positions of both activities; each difference exceeds about 199 of 200 random re-splits of the pooled data. [OCC001, DIR001, POS001, POS002, REL001]

A competing explanation the evidence cannot fully rule out is that A01 existed in the process earlier but was not exercised in any of the 200 earlier traces — zero participation strictly means only "not observed"; the evidence also says nothing about how A01 relates to activities other than A06. [OCC001, REL001]

Other differences: none — the backward shift of A06's position is part of the same insertion of A01 after it. [POS002]
